title: Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance
abstract: arXiv:2608.16238v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,7

translated_title: 基于现场性能的电池和电解槽系统多市场参与优化
translated_abstract: 可再生能源在电力系统中的占比不断增加，催生了对快速响应和灵活资源的需求，以维持系统稳定性。随着电力市场和辅助服务产品的扩展，跨多种服务叠加收入的机会应运而生。长期的电力转X（PTX）电解槽和短期的电池储能系统（BESS）是常见的灵活资源，但大多数研究忽视了实际硬件行为，如爬坡限制、效率和设定点跟踪精度。本研究展示了一个55千瓦/79千瓦时BESS和由三个2.4千瓦单元组成的电解槽的实验和建模结果。通过测量确定了关键特性，并将其嵌入到基于价格驱动的优化框架中，用于参与丹麦电力和辅助服务市场，利用了2022年至2025年的真实市场数据。多市场参与的优化日利润为1.7（单位未明确）。
tldr: 本研究基于实测硬件性能优化了电池和电解槽系统在丹麦多市场中的参与策略，显著提升了日利润。
en_tdlr: This study optimizes battery and electrolyser system participation in Danish multi-markets based on field-measured hardware performance, significantly enhancing daily profits.
